subtitle: The attribute that must never change, no matter what the source says

steps.label: Source changes
steps.sub: The upstream system updates the value

steps.label: ETL ignores it
steps.sub: No UPDATE ever targets this column

code:
INSERT INTO DimCustomer
  (CustomerKey, CustomerName, DateFirstPurchase)
VALUES (@key, @name, @today);

-- Later loads can update CustomerName (Type 1) —
-- DateFirstPurchase is never in that column list
UPDATE DimCustomer
SET    CustomerName = @newName
WHERE  CustomerKey = @key;
caption: DateFirstPurchase is set once at insert and excluded from every later UPDATE.
